plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Ubiquoss switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, fan status, power supply status, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 7800).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of the Ubiquoss device control plane as a 0-100 percentage, preferring the 1-minute scalar under IANA PEN 7800 and falling back to the 5-second then 5-minute windows when the preferred leaf is absent. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, routing instability, or attack traffic, and may lead to slow management response or packet processing delays.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: This metric reports allocated memory of the Ubiquoss device in bytes (ubiMemoryAlloc scalar, reported in kbyte and multiplied by 1024). Alloc is a quantity used as the numerator of memory utilization, not a precomputed percentage.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: This metric reports free memory of the Ubiquoss device in bytes (ubiMemoryFree scalar, reported in kbyte and multiplied by 1024). Together with total memory it provides the fallback utilization formula 1-Free/Total when Alloc is absent.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: This metric reports total memory of the Ubiquoss device in bytes (ubiMemoryTotal scalar, reported in kbyte and multiplied by 1024). It is the denominator for memory utilization.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports overall memory utilization of the Ubiquoss device as a 0-100 percentage, computed as Alloc/Total when Alloc is present, otherwise 1-Free/Total. Alloc is never treated as an already-normalized percent. High memory usage may indicate memory leaks, oversized routing/MAC/ARP tables, or insufficient capacity, and can cause instability or failed allocations.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the reading of each Ubiquoss temperature test point in degrees Celsius (ubiEnvMonTemperatureValue, one row per sensor). High temperatures can indicate cooling failure or airflow obstruction and risk thermal shutdown.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the fan state of the Ubiquoss switch (ubiEnvMonFanState), normalized so that 1 = healthy (normal / not present) and 2 = fault (warning / critical / shutdown / not functioning). A value greater than 1 indicates a fan failure that can lead to overheating.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the power supply state of the Ubiquoss switch (ubiEnvMonSupplyState), normalized so that 1 = healthy (normal / not present) and 2 = fault (warning / critical / shutdown / not functioning). A value greater than 1 indicates a power supply problem or lost redundancy.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
